**Bug:** Encrypting the same PDF twice overwrites `abc_encrypted.pdf` instead of creating a new file.

**Location:** `app/src/main/java/swati4star/createpdf/adapter/ViewFilesAdapter.java`, method `doEncryption()` (line 403)

**Root cause:** The output filename was always deterministic — `path.replace(".pdf", "_encrypted.pdf")` — so re-encrypting the same source PDF produced the exact same output path, silently overwriting the previous encrypted file.

**Fix applied:** Before writing, check if the target file already exists. If it does, generate a unique name by appending an 8-character UUID suffix: `abc_encrypted_<uuid>.pdf`.

**Build status:** `BUILD SUCCESSFUL in 15s`

The change adds one import (`java.util.UUID`) and modifies the `doEncryption` method with ~7 lines of logic — minimal, safe, and targeted.
